description: Fork of exp025 with d_qk 24→32 and d_v 12→16 (per-head capacity restored to exp020's). v_output_nap 8→16 to keep V votes/pair ≈ exp020's 68. Q/K kept as exp024/025 (output_nap=24/side, tph=512), giving joint votes/pair ≈ 24.8 — matching exp020's separate-Q/K density (24/496·512). Tests whether the slowdown in exp024/025 was due to small per-head dim (d_qk=24, d_v=12) or to H=6 + E=72 generally.
